prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1189; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a rear-end collision involving your insured. Effective immediately, please direct all communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any other party is represented by counsel, please forward this letter to them as well.

Please provide, within fifteen days of receipt, a certified copy of the declarations page for the policy in force at the time of the accident, including the bodily injury and property damage liability limits, along with a statement identifying any other applicable coverage, such as umbrella or excess policies.

We also demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, adjuster notes, vehicle and telematics data, repair estimates, and any dash camera or surveillance footage. Please suspend any routine deletion or destruction of these materials until this matter is fully resolved.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
